title: Set umask for KDE Plasma via systemd
summary: Configure the umask for KDE Plasma sessions, which are started as systemd user units and may ignore /etc/login.defs. This ensures consistent permissions in the graphical environment.

steps.explain:
Create the file /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/override.conf with the following content:
[Service]
UMask=0002
Replace 0002 with your desired umask value.
Log out and log back in for the changes to take effect.

warnings: This affects all user services started by systemd.
